title: fix: bill community videos from reported usage
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
## Changes
- Allow omitted video duration when the provider reports generated seconds in `usage.duration`.
- Bill reported duration first; fall back to requested duration only when usage is missing. Invalid reported usage or neither duration returns an error.
- Share the reader between registration and generation; update publisher and Scalar docs.

## Verification
187 focused tests pass; Gen and Enter typechecks pass. Coverage includes reported-duration priority, requested-duration fallback, all three media routes, failures without charges, and disconnect/rejoin/cache with one billed execution.

## Status
Directly tested `NamanSoni78/Seedance-2.5` without duration: HTTP 200 with a video URL but no usage. Existing calls with duration remain supported. The publisher still needs to report usage for duration-less calls from the media-to-Responses/Chat adapter. Draft pending that end-to-end check. No catalog pricing or routing changes.

gist.headline: Videos bill by the seconds
gist.blurb: Community video calls can now let the finished clip report its own runtime. The meter listens to what was actually generated, which is a surprisingly useful skill for a meter.
gist.summary: Community video billing now prioritizes provider-reported `usage.duration`, allowing requests to omit a duration when the provider returns generated seconds while preserving requested-duration fallback for existing calls.
gist.impact: Video creators can use duration-less community video requests with providers that report `usage.duration`, and billed executions use the generated runtime first; invalid or absent duration data returns a clear error without charging.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy community-video workstation where a retro monitor plays a tiny pixel film reel and reports its runtime on a receipt-like usage meter. Polli, wearing a little director beret, watches the meter carefully as a code-plant grows beside it, representing the provider reporting the actual generated seconds before billing.
